reviews.author: Daniel Ramos
reviews.text: Best group of guys who are honest, knowledgeable and their prices are fair. They have done oil changes for me, tires and even some brakes. Trust them completely.

reviews.author: Robert Mattei
reviews.text: Nice guys, great service, professional. Great shop! 4 tires mounted and balanced along with an alignment couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Paddy Bronson
reviews.text: Went in for window regulator and ac condenser replacement. Service was prompt, professional, friendly, and informative. The price was on the good side of reasonable especially considering their flexibility and quality of work. I can easily recommend to anyone needing some work done and they stand behind their work as well. Thanks santos repair!

reviews.author: Shon White
reviews.text: If your getting gas here watch out. Attendant on Sunday around 5pm January 28th 2018 took it upon himself to pump mid grade gas into our tank without asking. Paid cash to get the cheaper rate. So instead of 2.53 we paid 3.03. When questioned why he decided to do that he just had a shocked look on his already unfriendly face. More reason why self service gas needs to happen in New Jersey so you dont have to watch like a hawk people like this scamming customers. If you get gas here pay close attention. Hopefully management at this place isnt making this policy to scam customers. But if you read their YELP reviews you will find this common practice at this establishment.

reviews.author: Endangered Species
reviews.text: Broke my door hinge and cursed me out to replace. They would tell me to come get the hinge to get it replaced but when I get there they tell me to come a different day it's been well over a month now

reviews.author: Harold Aguilar
reviews.text: I had a terrible experience taking my car in for an alignment because I had replaced a CV joint. When I got my car back, I drove it a few miles and it was still the same as when I brought it in. They hadn't done the alignment. Be careful, they only say they're going to align it and then they don't actually do it.

reviews.author: Josue Carrillo
reviews.text: They work quickly when you need them, although it's quite expensive; they should be more considerate to get more customers.
